notes: Scale assumptions: H2 3.0 px/mm length and 3.4 px/mm thickness calibrated on the top-row Terumo boxes against the known Ultimaster Nagomi (250x16 mm). H3 has no reference carton; scale is carried over (3.3 px/mm length, 3.6 thickness) assuming similar camera distance and slightly wider cabinet; all H3 mm are rough (+/-20%). Corner points drawn by eye on 1:1 crops, +/-15 px; tilted boxes are leaning cartons (angles 8-13 deg in several rows). Size lists were read from small print and are not guaranteed; exemplar choice favoured clean upright boxes. Crops with annotated overlays in the scratch dir inv_b. Pouches (white paper) are listed under generic_paper_pouches. Cartons stand upright with spine facing camera except marked lying boxes. The brand names for COMBO Plus (OrbusNeich) and Tri-Wedge (Trireme) are inferred; neither brand is legible. Unidentified: teal/green/white box in H2 (crop inv_b/h2_teal.png), DES blue (inv_b/h2_des.png), Biotronik red/blue (inv_b/h2_red.png).
